name: Definition
formula: Let B and C be types, and f ∶B ↔C be a mapping. An inverse of f is a mapping g ∶C ↔B such that f #g = I = id ⌞B ⌟and g#f = I = id ⌞C ⌟. Theorem: If g is an inverse of a mapping f ∶B →C, then g = f ⌣.
